declarations.docstring: An auxiliary self-map on the partitions of each natural number.
The complex-algebra endomorphism that twists permutation monomials by their signs.
An auxiliary monoid homomorphism from permutations of a finite type into the associated algebra.
The sign-twisting algebra endomorphism is bijective.
Applying the sign twist to the partition-indexed auxiliary element gives the sum of the corresponding permutation monomials.
The image under the sign twist of the ideal generated by one element is the ideal generated by its image.
On a permutation monomial, the sign twist multiplies that monomial by the sign of the permutation.
The sign twist of the partition-indexed auxiliary element is the sum of permutation monomials weighted by their signs.
The action of a sign-twisted permutation monomial is its original action scaled by the permutation sign.
There is an auxiliary map on the indicated partition-indexed subtype that intertwines permutation action with its sign twist.
